name: Regression Testing Checklist
description: This module is a short pre-completion checklist of specific items to verify before marking any regression testing task, implementation, or piece of work complete.
content:
This module is a short pre-completion checklist of specific items to verify before marking any regression testing task, implementation, or piece of work complete.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. Keep regression testing outputs reproducible: fix seeds, record versions, and avoid hidden non-determinism where it matters.
2. Before starting regression testing work, confirm the scope and constraints so the approach matches the actual requirement.
3. Keep regression testing changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
4. Surface known limitations of a chosen regression testing approach instead of presenting it as complete when it is not.
5. Re-check edge cases relevant to regression testing (empty input, boundary values, concurrent access) before calling the task done.
6. When multiple regression testing strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
7. Check that regression testing terminology is used consistently throughout, matching existing conventions in the surrounding context.
8. Prefer explicit, readable regression testing solutions over clever ones that are hard to verify.
9. State assumptions about regression testing explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Avoid mixing unrelated regression testing concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.
- Avoid introducing new regression testing abstractions before there is a second concrete use case that needs them.
- Do not apply generic regression testing advice without checking it fits the specific context at hand.

CLOSING NOTE
These guidelines are a starting point for regression testing, not an exhaustive rulebook — use judgment when a rule doesn't fit the situation.
